digest.component_or_area: store write seams and CI lint
propositions: Production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c class) resulted from store write paths that bypassed canonical write seams using raw git add/commit/rm, including in GitHub workflow YAML (reconcile-bridge.yml bare git add -A without tracker token)

Two legitimate sanctioned store write seams exist: (1) store seam with locked write transactions and event appends in gitutil/event_append/txn/purge_bridge, and (2) reconciler seam via git_adapter and _ref_lock

Deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST layer for subprocess git mutations and wrapper calls; workflow/shell layer for cwd-aware tracker context) must flag raw git mutations by default and require inline mandatory-reason markers (# raw-git-ok: <reason>) for sanction

Lint detects raw git mutations via two rules: R1 matches subprocess invocations with git mutation verbs (add/commit/rm/mv/reset/update-ref/checkout/clean) resolved through local intra-function tracking; R2 matches calls to wrapper names (run_git, run_git_write, _run_git, _git) with mutation verbs, with fail-closed behavior on opaque argv

Report-mode bootstrap establishes authoritative hit inventory before enforcement; all hits are remediated or marked with reasoned markers (seam internals, store-maintenance callers, disposable-workspace sites like eval_solver, criterion_preview, review_bot/gerrit_client, opcert_service/workspace)
Teaching message directs authors to store write APIs (event-append, transaction, reconciler git_adapter) and explains inline marker sanction; marker-without-reason fails the lint
